_comment: Reviewed corrections to traits derived from ability text (src/d2bg/knowledge/traits.py). Each entry was checked by hand against the hero's ability descriptions in data/snapshot/abilities.json.

storm_spirit.why: Static Remnant is a charged image that explodes, not an illusion

invoker.why: Ghost Walk is an invoked spell, stored as a hidden ability

clinkz.why: Death Pact heals Clinkz himself, not allies

night_stalker.why: Dark Ascension mentions flying, not a summoned unit

spectre.why: Haunt reaches every enemy hero wherever they are
